author: Unreal Engine
description: Join us as Huiwen Jiang shares practical tips and advice from their experience investigating and fixing GPU crashes in UE5. This talk aims to help developers move from 'no idea where to start' to building a clear, methodical approach for diagnosing GPU crash issues. They will also introduce recent progress in related debugging tools and how to apply them in real-world cases.
title: A Deep Dive into GPU Crashes in UE5 | Inside Unreal

description:
Watch this video to discover how UE5 brings high-definition visuals, refined controls, and updated cinematics to ‘Halo: Campaign Evolved’, a faithful yet modernized remake of the legendary ‘Halo: Combat Evolved’ campaign.

We caught up with Halo Studio’s Principal Producer Casey Wu and Game Director Greg Hermann to find out which Unreal Engine 5 features stood out to the team most during development and what the team hopes this project will be remembered for in the future.
